Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Role Summary

As Fraud Operations Manager, you will own the day-to-day operations of Imprint's fraud operations team, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality across internal specialists and an outsourced BPO workforce. This is a hands-on people management role with direct accountability for team performance, SOP integrity, and vendor oversight as the team scales rapidly.

You will act as the operational backbone of fraud ops — closing gaps between what the process says and what agents actually do, and building systems that scale rather than just managing queues.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • All team leads have structured coaching, guidance, and feedback in place, with productivity and QA measurements actively tracked

  • SOP gaps are identified, documented, and on a clear path to bank compliance sign-off

  • BPO (Ubiquity) QA scorecard is accurate, current, and measuring vendor performance against defined standards

  • Consistency across a team of 49 BPO agents and 22 specialists is meaningfully improved

  • Established as a trusted escalation point for fraud operations across the team

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle people management for fraud operations, including team leads, internal specialists, and BPO vendor workforce

  • Drive SOP development, gap identification, and compliance approval processes to ensure all procedures are documented, current, and bank-approved

  • Manage the BPO relationship — maintain QA scorecards, hold vendors accountable to performance standards, and coach vendor agents directly

  • Partner with fraud strategy on workflow changes and emerging fraud trends without acting as a blocker

  • Serve as the escalation backstop for fraud operations issues and always bring a recommendation when raising a problem

  • Balance fraud prevention with user experience — treat false positives as a real cost, not just a fraud metric

  • Use data and operational insight to identify bottlenecks and drive process improvements

  • Build systems and processes that scale with rapid team growth

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience owning fraud or dispute operations in a regulated consumer credit or banking environment

  • Demonstrated experience managing an outsourced/BPO workforce — including vendor QA, scorecards, and performance accountability

  • Has written SOPs and obtained compliance approval for them in a compliance-gated process

  • Proven people management experience, including direct oversight of team leads or frontline operations staff

  • Owns outcomes without being prompted — closes the loop, follows through, and brings solutions alongside problems

  • Direct communicator with both vendors and internal peers

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with transaction fraud monitoring platforms (e.g., Sardine or similar)

  • Experience with application decisioning and KYC processes

  • Proficiency in ticketing and workflow tools (e.g., Zendesk)

  • Ability to independently build analytical views using SQL, Sigma, or data visualization tools

  • Workforce management experience

  • Experience designing written processes — SOPs, escalation processes, QA sampling plans

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

raw.description:
Job Title: Performance Marketing Manager (Web)

Department: Growth & Marketing
Employment type: Full-Time

About ImagineArt

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.

ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups, with zero outside funding.

  • $35M+ ARR crossed this year

  • 100M+ social impressions

  • Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world, and we're just getting started.

Almost all of that growth has come from people finding us and subscribing on the web. We are now hiring someone to own that engine properly.

About the Role

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition for our web product.

This is a web-first role. You will own the funnel from ad impression to paid subscription, across Meta, TikTok and Google, with real budget behind it from day one. ImagineArt is a consumer subscription product, so the numbers that matter to you are CAC, payback window and trial to paid conversion, not lead volume or MQLs.

The honest constraint in this role is creative. In consumer AI, paid social rewards volume and iteration speed more than clever targeting, and you will be shipping a lot of creative against a product that generates images and video. That is an unusual advantage and we want someone who will actually use it.

What You'll Do

Own paid acquisition on the web

  • Own strategy and daily execution across Meta, TikTok and Google

  • Manage budget at real scale, with responsibility for CAC and payback targets

  • Build and scale web to web and web to app funnels, including paywall and checkout testing

Make the funnel convert

  • Run structured CRO on landing pages, paywalls, pricing and onboarding

  • Own trial to paid conversion alongside product and growth

  • Build the measurement setup you need, from attribution through to incrementality testing

Ship creative at volume

  • Work with designers, editors and creators to keep a constant flow of new ad concepts

  • Build a testing cadence where losing creative is killed fast and winners are scaled

  • Use ImagineArt itself, and AI tooling generally, to compress the time from idea to live ad

Own the numbers

  • Report on spend, CAC, payback, LTV and contribution margin honestly, including what is not working

  • Forecast what more budget would actually buy

  • Decide where the next dollar goes

What We're Looking For

Required

  • You have personally managed $1M+ USD in paid media. Not an agency aggregate across many clients, not a team total. Budget you owned.

  • Direct experience with consumer subscription economics: CAC, payback window, trial to paid

  • Hands-on ownership of Meta, TikTok or Google at meaningful daily spend

  • Web funnel experience. You have built and optimised web checkout or paywall flows, not only app store installs.

  • You can show your own numbers and explain what you would do differently

Nice to have

  • Experience in consumer AI, creative tools, or another category where creative volume is the bottleneck

  • AI tooling already inside your own workflow, not just as a product you market

  • Experience scaling in more than one market or language

  • Comfort working across time zones with a distributed team

Not a fit if

  • Your experience is mainly B2B lead generation or brand marketing

  • Your spend figure is an agency total rather than budget you owned

  • You need a large existing team and established processes to be effective

How We'll Assess You

We will ask you one question early, so you may as well know it now: what is the largest monthly budget you personally owned, on a single account, and what was the payback window. Bring real numbers. We would much rather hear about a channel that stopped working and what you did about it than a highlight reel.

Why Join

  • Profitable, no outside funding, so the growth is real and so is the budget

  • A product that makes the creative your ads depend on

  • Direct access to founders and genuine ownership of the number

  • Full-time, and we are flexible on location for the right person

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role

As Legal Counsel at Reserv, you will be an early and integral member of our growing legal function, working closely with the VP of Legal to support all aspects of the company's legal needs. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-moving, venture-backed insurtech leader at an exciting stage of growth — and to gain broad, hands-on experience across transactional, commercial, and operational legal matters.

You'll operate as a true generalist: one day you might be reviewing vendor and customer agreements, the next day advising the product team on data privacy considerations, and the next helping develop internal playbooks and processes. You don't need to be an insurance industry veteran or insurance law expert — a willingness to learn the space combined with strong foundational legal skills are what matter most.

Who You Are

  • Self-Starter: You are organized, detail-oriented, and take ownership of your work — you don't need to be told the same thing twice.
  • Clear Communicator: You can communicate clearly and concisely with both legal and non-legal audiences, and know when to escalate versus when to move forward.
  • Business-Minded: You have a practical, commercial sensibility — you understand that legal exists to enable the business, not just protect it.
  • Eager Learner: You're intellectually curious and eager to develop expertise in new areas, including insurance, claims, and the regulatory landscape around AI and automation.
  • Adaptable: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and are comfortable building processes from scratch when needed.
  • Ethically Grounded: You hold yourself and others to high ethical standards and handle sensitive matters with discretion.
  • And of course — a sense of humor goes a long way around here.

What You'll Do

Contracts & Transactional Support

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements including customer and vendor contracts, SaaS agreements, NDAs, and partnership agreements.
  • Support contract lifecycle management, helping build and maintain scalable templates and playbooks.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance to move deals forward efficiently.

Employment Law and HR Operations

  • Partner with People Ops to assist with corporate policies, the employee handbook, and the employee review process.
  • Assist with employment-related disputes and internal investigations.
  • Advise People Ops partners regarding hiring and employment law matters across 50 states and internationally.

Legal Operations

  • Help build and improve internal legal processes, templates, and workflows as the company scales.
  • Maintain organized records of contracts, corporate documents, and legal correspondence.
  • Support due diligence and data room preparation for financing rounds or other strategic transactions.

Compliance & Risk

  • Assist with regulatory and compliance matters, including those specific to the insurance and TPA industry.
  • Support the VP of Legal in tracking and interpreting relevant laws and regulations across the jurisdictions (nationally and internationally) in which Reserv operates.
  • Help identify and flag potential legal risks across business units proactively.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product & Engineering on legal considerations related to AI, data privacy, and new feature development.
  • Support outside counsel coordination for specialized matters such as IP, litigation, and international issues.
  • Serve as a reliable, approachable resource for teammates across the company.

Requirements

  • 4–6 years of legal experience with a law firm, in-house, or a combination.
  • Strong generalist foundation — experience across commercial contracts, corporate matters, employment practices, litigation, and/or regulatory compliance.
  • Prior Big Law or mid-size firm experience in formative years strongly preferred.
  • In-house experience at a startup, tech company, or high-growth business is a plus.
  • Experience in insurance, insurtech or fintech is a plus, but not required — we will teach you what you need to know.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active admission to a state bar in the United States.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally as needed.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

raw.description:
CTEC is a leading technology firm that provides modernization, digital transformation, and application development services to the U.S. Federal Government. Headquartered in McLean, VA, CTEC has over 300 team members working on mission-critical systems and projects for agencies such as the Department of Homeland Security, Internal Revenue Service, and the Office of Personnel Management. The work we do effects millions of U.S. citizens daily as they interact with the systems we build. Our best-in-class commercial solutions, modified for our customers’ bespoke mission requirements, are enabling this future every day.

The Company has experienced rapid growth over the past 3 years and recently received a strategic investment from Main Street Capital Corporation (NYSE: MAIN). In addition to our recent growth in Federal Civilian agencies, we are seeking to expand our capabilities in cloud development and footprint in national-security focused agencies within the Department of Defense and U.S. Intelligence Community.

We are seeking to hire a Technical Project Manager to our team!

Client:
CTEC develops and delivers innovative customer-centric technologies and solutions that support the Office of Personnel Management’s (OPM) Health and Insurance business unit and Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO).

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Agile Program & Team Leadership: Lead and manage Agile delivery teams using Scrum and Agile-at-Scale methodologies to deliver complex technology solutions on schedule and within scope.
  • Roadmap & Work Plan Management: Create, manage, and maintain project roadmaps, sprint plans, and release schedules using Azure DevOps to support iterative development and delivery.
  • Requirements & Scope Management: Oversee requirements discovery and documentation in collaboration with business analysts and technical teams, ensuring business needs are accurately captured before solution development.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the primary interface between government stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to align expectations, communicate progress, and resolve issues.
  • Solution Delivery Oversight: Ensure technical solutions meet defined business, functional, and non-functional requirements, supporting successful implementation and client satisfaction.
  • Impediment & Risk Management: Identify and manage team blockers, conflicts, risks, and scope changes; maintain risk registers and issue logs; and escalate as necessary.
  • Agile Ceremony Facilitation: Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and executive reporting sessions.
  • Process & Change Management: Analyze current-state processes, define future-state improvements, and guide teams through change adoption and transformation.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Coordinate across development, data, QA, architecture, and business teams to ensure integrated solution delivery.
  • Reporting & Executive Communication: Assemble and present project status, metrics, risks, and performance reports to management and executive stakeholders.
  • Tool & Platform Management: Leverage Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Microsoft OneDrive to manage project artifacts, documentation, collaboration, and traceability.
  • Continuous Improvement: Promote continuous improvement of Agile practices, delivery processes, and team performance.
  • Works under minimal supervision with minor guidance from senior personnel.

Skills & Work Experience:

  • Professional Experience: At least ten (10+) years of experience in technical project management, Agile delivery, or program management roles supporting enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Agile/Scrum teams and delivering technology solutions in cloud-based environments.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, reporting, and traceability.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC methodologies including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall.
  • Experience managing cross-functional technical teams including software engineers, data engineers, architects, and QA teams.
  • Experience with cloud technology environments, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Strong change management and process improvement experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting.
  • Excellent organizational, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting U.S. federal government IT programs, preferably within OPM or similar agencies.
  • Experience managing DevOps or cloud engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with enterprise collaboration platforms including SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive.
  • Experience delivering data modernization or analytics platform implementations.
  • Experience supporting technology modernization or digital transformation programs.

Education & Certification:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. PMP certification preferred.

Scrum Master certification preferred.

Clearance:
Must be a U.S. citizen and be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

If you are looking for a fun and challenging environment with talented, motivated people to work with, CTEC is the right place for you. In addition to employee salary, we offer an array of employee benefits including:

  • Paid vacation & Sick leave

  • Health insurance coverage

  • Career training

  • Performance bonus programs

  • 401K contribution & Employer Match

  • 11 Federal Holidays

raw.title: Engineering Project Management Associate - REMOTE
raw.excerpt: Be part of an amazing storyMacy’s is more than just a store.
raw.description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Associate, Engineering Project Management manages and oversees all aspects of execution for Macy’s Supply Chain material handling and construction capital projects.

This is a remote role and can be based anywhere in the US. Must have conveyor and automation experience (Installation design, and project management of that installation). This is not an entry level role and we require 75% travel.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as project owner and Macy’s lead for large-scale capital material handling equipment and warehouse projects exceeding $100 million. Coordinate efforts across vendors, Macy’s Supply Chain Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, and Macy’s Technology.
  • Oversee all aspects of project management, including cost control, engineering deliverables, construction scheduling, testing, go-live activities, turnover, quality assurance, and closeout.
  • Collaborate with site managers to maintain project timelines, ensure smooth turnover to operations, and complete project closeout activities.
  • Partner with Program Managers, Operations & Facilities, Maintenance, and cross-functional teams to plan and drive engineering execution.
  • Provide clear direction and issue resolution for contractors, vendors, and suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, identifying dependencies and critical path tasks.
  • Partner with vendors and stakeholders to compress timelines and proactively address delays through mitigation planning.
  • Lead project coordination meetings and maintain consistent communication with all team members to ensure alignment on deliverables and expectations.
  • Conduct field visits to monitor progress, assess work quality, and resolve on-site issues.
  • Facilitate and lead budget creation, work breakdown structures, cost estimates, prioritization, and integration planning with senior leadership and program managers.
  • Resolve project challenges and ensure accountability for results.
  • Provide schedule guidance and duration estimates for future projects.
  • Review blueprints and construction documents to evaluate project status, identify issues, and drive timely resolution.
  • Identify and address equipment errors, collaborating with operations teams for timely resolution.
  • Enforce all Macy’s safety and construction protocols to achieve zero accidents, zero unplanned operational disruptions, and zero environmental incidents.
  • Work with Procurement to secure competitive pricing through bidding and support vendor selection.
  • Collaborate with Design Engineering on project scope, technical requirements, cost estimates, budgets, and schedules.
  • Partner with Capital Administration, Legal, and Risk teams to issue vendor contracts and prepare internal approval documents as required.
  • Maintain project budget tracking and identify cost-saving opportunities in collaboration with Procurement and vendor partners.
  • Track and resolve punch list items to ensure project completion and quality standards are met.
  • Maintain accurate records, forecasts, and schedules for all assigned projects, ensuring completeness and accuracy of vendor proposals before contract issuance.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Project Management & Execution: Ability to lead large-scale capital projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment across engineering, operations, procurement, and technology teams.

Construction & Engineering Oversight: Strong understanding of warehouse material handling systems, blueprints, and construction processes to ensure design accuracy, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery.

Financial & Budget Management: Skilled in managing multimillion-dollar project budgets, controlling costs, and identifying opportunities for savings through vendor negotiations and process optimization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong partnership skills; able to work effectively with program managers, operations, maintenance, procurement, legal, and vendors to drive alignment and resolve issues quickly.

Vendor & Contract Management: Proficient in overseeing vendor bidding, selection, and contract administration in collaboration with Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure compliance and cost-effectiveness.

Analytical Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, assess risks, and implement practical, data-driven solutions.

Technical Proficiency: Experienced in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Bluebeam, AutoCAD, and project management software; knowledge of Material Handling Systems, PLCs, and ladder logic preferred.

Communication & Leadership: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present information clearly, influence stakeholders, and lead cross-functional teams effectively.

Detail Orientation & Quality Control: Highly organized and detail-oriented; ensures accuracy in project documentation, manages punch lists, and maintains quality standards throughout execution.

Sense of Urgency & Initiative: Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to prioritize and drive results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Who You Are

  • Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.
  • This position requires heavy lifting, constant moving, remaining in a stationary position, and reaching with arms and hands. Involves remaining in a stationary position for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 30 lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders. May involve reaching above eye level. Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Able to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on department and company needs.
  • Able to travel 75%.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

About Truegenics

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialize in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience.
We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and we are committed to creating products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Senior Graphic & Web Designer who is passionate about creating meaningful brand experiences. Someone who combines creativity with technical precision and takes full ownership of their work.
You will be the visual voice of our brands, shaping how our products look, feel, and perform across packaging and web experiences. This is a fully remote role, so clear communication, strong collaboration, and accountability are key to your success.
You will partner closely with the marketing, copywriting, and sales teams to create designs that not only look exceptional but also deliver measurable results, driving conversions, strengthening brand reputation, and deepening customer loyalty.

Mission of the Role

To elevate Truegenics’ visual identity across all touchpoints by ensuring every design supports business objectives, reinforces brand integrity, and resonates with our target audience.
As a senior creative, you will lead by example, maintaining design excellence, guiding junior team members, and setting high standards for creativity, performance, and consistency across all brands.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic & Packaging Design (30%)

  • Conceptualize and execute creative ideas for digital and packaging projects based on brand direction, marketing briefs, and customer experience principles.
  • Design and adapt packaging across product lines using established brand templates, ensuring consistency while introducing fresh variations for new launches.
  • Create digital design assets for websites, social media, emails, and campaigns that engage users and drive conversions.
  • Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity across all design outputs, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
  • Develop and evolve key brand visuals including logos, icons, color systems, typography, and layout frameworks.
  • Translate marketing strategies into visually compelling campaigns that strengthen brand equity and support sales growth.
  • Mentor and guide junior designers, providing clear feedback and creative direction to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Research and incorporate emerging design trends, creative formats, and audience insights to keep the brand relevant and competitive.

Web Design & Frontend Development (70%)

  • Design and develop responsive, high-performing web pages with a strong mobile-first approach, ensuring layouts, navigation, and performance are optimized for mobile users.
  • Collaborate with marketing, media, and copywriting teams to design and optimize eCommerce landing pages that convert effectively across devices.
  • Apply UX/UI best practices to build layouts that are visually engaging, intuitive to navigate, and optimized for performance.
  • Develop reusable page templates and modular design systems to improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
  • Ensure all web assets meet quality standards for responsiveness, accessibility, and loading performance.
  • Coordinate the execution of promotional web materials, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency, and timely delivery.
  • Review and refine the work of junior designers, providing constructive feedback that enhances both creative quality and execution.

Key Requirements

  • Strong portfolio showcasing both digital and web design work. Clear examples of mobile-first design projects will be a plus.
  • Expertise in responsive and mobile UX/UI design, including optimizing layouts, images, and performance for smaller screens.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline creative processes, generate ideas, or enhance productivity (for example, generating layout variations, assisting with copy, or automating production tasks).
  • Willingness to learn, explore, and adopt new AI tools to improve design quality and efficiency.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present ideas, feedback, and updates clearly in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Self-driven, highly organized, and accountable to deadlines.
  • Skilled in managing multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable collaborating through digital tools and workflows such as Figma, Slack, and Wrike.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates who can collaborate effectively across digital platforms and time zones.

The potential hire must also be equipped with the following to carry out this role effectively:

  • Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed
  • At least 1 monitor screen (inclusive of laptop screen)
  • Headset with Mic (Noise cancelling)
  • Webcam
  • Designated Workstation
  • Stable and strong power and internet connectivity
  • Noise-free and conducive environment

Cardinal Health Sonexus™ Access and Patient Support helps specialty pharmaceutical manufacturers remove barriers to care so that patients can access, afford and remain on the therapy they need for a better quality of life. Our diverse expertise in pharma, payer and hub services allows us to deliver best-in-class solutions—driving brand and patient markers of success. We’re continuously integrating advanced and emerging technologies to streamline patient onboarding, qualification and adherence. Our non-commercial specialty pharmacy is centralized at our custom-designed facility outside of Dallas, Texas, empowering manufacturers to rethink the reach and impact of their products.

Job Description

As the leading provider of comprehensive pharmaceutical commercialization services, Sonexus Health empowers pharmaceutical manufacturers by integrating innovative distribution models with patient access, adherence programs and reimbursement services. Patients start therapy faster and stay compliant longer, while manufacturers own their provider relationships and gain actionable, real-time visibility into how, when and why their products are used.

Position Summary

Technical Account Management (TAM) is responsible for playing a key/critical role in realizing business value through the application of project management knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques to meet project objectives. The TAM will also use their rich healthcare domain expertise, along with project management and proactive consulting skills, to solve complex technical challenges for some of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in the country. To our clients, this individual will be an expert in combining our technology platform and solutions with their programs to provide maximum benefit to their business and patients.

Role contribution and responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates advanced knowledge of Cardinal Health and customer industry, including key competitors, terminology, technology, trends, challenges, reimbursement and government regulation; demonstrates working knowledge of how Cardinal Health technical offerings match with a customers' unique business needs

  • Demonstrates knowledge of the project management initiating, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing processes.

  • Monitors performance and recommends scope, schedule, cost or resource adjustments

  • Connects short-term demands to long-term implications, in alignment with the supporting business case.

  • Prioritizes multiple tasks while meeting deadlines

  • Communicates project status (health, forecast, issues, risks, etc.) to stakeholders in an open and honest fashion.

  • Effectively balances competing project constraints including but not limited to scope, quality, schedule, funding, budget, resources, and risk, to manage project success.

  • Provides input to contracts, reviews contracts to ensure completeness of scope and appropriate accountability based on role and/or responsibility.

  • Negotiates with stakeholders to obtain the resources necessary for successful project execution.

  • Partners with stakeholders and technologist to implement/automate/operationalize models into day-to-day business decision making.

  • High level of client contact in an Account Management portfolio approach.

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects

  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals

  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models

  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope

  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact

  • Provides solutions which may set precedent

  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects

  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives

  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

  • Identifies and qualifies opportunities within service portfolio (including but not limited to technology, program design, services expansion, etc.…) with existing client and develops plans for introducing new solutions through collaborative relationships

Accountabilities in this role

  • Analyze and recommend technical solutions related to new product launches, product discontinuations, vendor integrations, and operational efficiencies among other potential services

  • Acts as single technical liaison for the client

  • Daily interactions with client to assess and advise client needs and requests

  • Analyze client program, needs and propose solutions and options that provide value to client

  • Recommend technical changes/updates/enhancements to current platform and vendor integration landscape to further align with client’s strategy and industry advancements.

  • Manage client deliverables, timelines, and artifacts

  • Monitor team backlog and prioritize activities to deliver on time, on budget, on scope

  • Anticipate client needs and proactively make program recommendations to enhance service value

  • Perform necessary project administration, project status, and risk, issue management

Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree preferred

  • 3-5 years' experience of client relationship management experience at the account management level preferred

  • Prior experience working in a Specialty Pharmaceutical HUB environment, preferred

  • 8+ years’ experience in professional services, healthcare, or related field preferred serving in a technical capacity preferred

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products preferred

  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with executive facing presentation experience

  • Strong project management skills

  • Proven ability to learn an application of advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects

  • Travel requirement up to 10%

TRAINING AND WORK SCHEDULES:

  • Your new hire training will take place 8:00am-5:00pm CST, mandatory attendance is required.

  • This position is full-time (40 hours/week).

  • Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our shift schedules during our normal business hours of Monday-Friday, 7:00am- 7:00pm CST.

REMOTE DETAILS:

  • You will work remotely, full-time. It will require a dedicated, quiet, private, distraction free environment with access to high-speed internet.

  • We will provide you with the computer, technology and equipment needed to successfully perform your job.

  • You will be responsible for providing high-speed internet.

  • Internet requirements include the following:

  • Maintain a secure, high-speed, broadband internet connection (DSL, Cable, or Fiber) at the remote location. Dial-up, satellite, WIFI, Cellular connections are NOT acceptable.

  • Download speed of 15Mbps (megabyte per second)

  • Upload speed of 5Mbps (megabyte per second)

  • Ping Rate Maximum of 30ms (milliseconds)

  • Hardwired to the router

  • Surge protector with Network Line Protection for CAH issued equipment

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within Europe to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within Europe.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

About the role

Hostaway is looking for a Lead AI GTM Engineer to build the systems, workflows, and AI-powered tools that make our global marketing team faster, smarter, and more effective.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of how modern marketing teams operate. You will work across Brand, Content, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, and Marketing Operations to identify where AI can improve performance, reduce manual work, and increase the quality and speed of execution.

You will decide where to buy, build, or automate; design and deploy agents and workflows; integrate AI into our marketing technology stack; and measure whether those solutions improve marketing performance and ROI.

This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You should be equally comfortable mapping a complex GTM workflow, evaluating a new AI platform, building an agent, connecting systems through APIs, and explaining the business impact to senior marketing leaders.

Your mission

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions, including agents, multi-step workflows, automations, and internal tools that solve real marketing problems.

    • For example, building a campaign builder that allows a marketer to input a brief, and the agentic workflow creates all of the assets, including versions and localizations, and connects to platforms like Meta/LinkedIn/Google to execute the ads in market.

  • Own build-vs-buy decisions by evaluating emerging AI and GTM platforms, testing their capabilities, and determining when to implement an existing solution versus build something custom.

  • Integrate AI agents and workflows with our marketing platforms, data sources, APIs, and internal systems.

    • For example, you can build an email automation workflow that connects to our platform to identify signals that would trigger an email cadence with all the branching logic, including writing the email, and connecting to HubSpot to deploy the email.

  • Establish AI evaluation and quality standards by testing accuracy, reliability, and output quality and continuously improving production workflows.

  • Optimize the economics of AI across token usage, API consumption, software costs, infrastructure, and human effort.

  • Stay ahead of emerging models, agent frameworks, platforms, and approaches, turning the most promising developments into practical advantages for Hostaway.

Requirements

  • Full-stack builder: Past engineering experience required, and you can independently design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered applications, agents, and multi-step workflows.

  • AI engineering expertise: You have built AI agents and agentic workflows that have measurably improved team performance. This requires you to be comfortable working across models, APIs, orchestration frameworks, and coding environments such as Claude Code or similar tools.

  • AI platform fluency: You have hands-on experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI and GTM platforms such as Qualified, Clay, Jasper, Copy.ai, HubSpot Breeze, or similar tools, and you can quickly determine if they solve real-world business problems.

  • Platform integration expertise: You know how to connect systems. You have hands-on experience integrating platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Meta, Google, and LinkedIn and creating reliable data flows between them.

  • GTM fluency: You understand how modern B2B marketing works across brand, content, demand generation, product marketing, and marketing operations, and how those teams work together across the buyer journey and funnel.

  • Strong economic judgment: You understand the cost of automation and can evaluate tradeoffs between human effort, purchased software, API consumption, infrastructure, and token usage to choose the most efficient solution.

  • Data acquisition expertise: You are comfortable using APIs, web scraping, and other methods to turn external data into structured inputs for marketing, competitive intelligence, targeting, and automation.

  • Able to navigate ambiguity: You can identify the highest-impact opportunities, make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information, and move quickly from idea to working solution without needing heavy process or a large team.

What we offer

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

  • 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

  • Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

  • Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

  • Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

  • Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

  • Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

  • Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

You will work closely with business partners and teammates at all levels of the Technology and Communications teams to prepare for and manage Technology-wide business initiatives and messaging, including topics related to emerging technologies such as AI.

In addition to providing strategic counsel, you will play a hands-on role in building and executing the team’s annual communications plan. Throughout the year, you will direct a broad range of communication activities across a variety of channels to maximize message clarity, consistency, engagement, and effectiveness.

This role requires someone who is energized by challenges, complex subject matter, and critical thinking. The successful candidate will excel at managing relationships, adapting to changing circumstances, and bringing a growth mindset to complex work.

Key Role Functions

  • Lead communications strategy for initiatives within Humana Technology, implementing tactics that prioritize message delivery and employee engagement within the team and across the broader organization

Use your skills to make an impact

raw.description:
Why join Conveyor?

Hi, we’re Conveyor 👋, creators of the #1 Customer Trust AI automation platform.

We solve problems that our customers “hate with the fury of 1000 suns” (actual quote!) - the dreaded customer security review and RFP processes. These are key parts of the B2B sales cycle, but both still involve too much time, effort, and mental anguish from those involved.

Enter Conveyor, where our mission is to eliminate all of the misery from B2B customer trust with maximum automation. We’ve made a lot of progress – we have an awesome customer list whose lives we’vesignificantly impacted through product, this year we launched the first AI agents for security reviews (Sue) and RFPs (Phil), and we just raised a $20M Series B from SignalFire and OVF! (TechCrunch) But we have ambitious goals and we’re looking for our next Staff AI Engineer to help make them a reality!

The top 3 1/2 reasons you should be interested in working at Conveyor:

  1. You’ll be selling a great product with a slam dunk AI use case while building sales processes and foundations to help scale the business.

  2. Everyone on the team is amazing at their jobs. We care deeply aboutpsychological safety, and believe that the ability to take risks and exist in thelearning zone is critical to our success. This also comes with high accountability, which isn’t for everyone. But, you have the potential to have an outsize impact on the direction and success of the company.

  3. We’re highly transparent and collaborative. Giving constructive, thoughtful feedback and asking hard questions are highly encouraged! We come together to figure it out when times are hard, and in celebration when we get our wins.
    1/2. Plus, we’ll even teach you how to saber a bottle of champagne

About the Role

As one of the first AI engineers on the team, this is a unique opportunity to shape Conveyor’s AI core capabilities, and create a huge impact on a critical pillar in our product strategy. Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll play a critical role in building and optimizing our AI development process and further building the team.

What you’ll do:

  • You will analyze our AI quality and performance, propose and experiment with new technologies and ideas, then implement and improve Conveyor products.

  • You will define and implement metrics and processes to evaluate and improve AI quality.

  • You'll autonomously manage and own individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • You’ll scope and implement project-level solutions with minimal guidance. 

  • You’ll collaborate and pair frequently with teammates and peers.

  • You'll inform the product roadmap and implementation decisions based on feasibility.

  • You'll ensure that our product is maintainable, meaning that other engineers are able to contribute new functionality easily, and without frequent technical debt.

  • You'll partner with Product and Design to effectively plan new features, avoiding bottlenecks and maximizing velocity when it comes time to implement.

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for candidates with 8+ years of experience in technical leadership roles, with a focus on AI/ML technologies in recent years. Strong preference for experience in startup environments.

Required Skills

  • Strong software engineering foundations, building and shipping products. Your designs should be performant, maintainable (for years, not months), and evolvable.

  • Recent experience in the AI/ML space, and specifically LLMs. Familiarity with key concepts, frameworks, tools and technologies. Experience evaluating different approaches and technologies, prompt engineering, evals and observability, RAG flows, search technologies, agent frameworks, etc.

  • Able to perform both research/analysis and production software development work

  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: You are up to speed on developments in the fast-paced AI/ML world, and constantly thinking about how to apply new technologies and offerings to our real-world problems.

  • Bias for action: Startup mentality, get things done, fast iterations, strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Previous experience in a small startup (or as a founder) is highly preferred.

  • Product Sense: You seek to understand the features you're working on, and actively propose positive changes. Collaborate with product and design to inform roadmap decisions.

  • Team Player: You have excellent communication skills (verbal and written), enjoy collaborating with others and mentoring team members.

  • Deliver Legendary Customer Experience: You have experience building and scaling products that delight real users.

  • Ownership: Strong sense of ownership and accountability, honor commitments and be transparent about challenges.

Job Location

This position is available in the United States and Canada.

We are a remote-first company so you’ll be working from home most of the time, traveling for in person sessions a few times a year.

Preferred location: San Francisco Bay Area

Ready to join our team and have a tremendous impact? We’d love to hear from you. Also, we know it’s tough, but please try to avoid the ​​confidence gap​.​​ You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

Business Systems Analyst

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Function: Systems and Data
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt, Salaried
Location: Remote (U.S.)

About Mutual

Mutual Group is a mission-driven, independent financial services firm founded more than 40 years ago and headquartered in Southern California. Through our broker-dealer and registered investment adviser subsidiaries, we support more than 1,600 financial professionals nationwide and oversee in excess of $13 billion in assets. Our culture is grounded in our values: Personal, Authentic, Collaborative, and Knowledgeable. We take pride in serving our advisors and clients with integrity, expertise, and care.

Position Overview

The Business Systems Analyst is a key member of the Technology team, responsible for the business requirements gathering, design, and management of automations, workflows, and integrations across the firm's systems. A significant aspect of this role will be focusing on the management of AI platforms and agents, ensuring they align with strategic initiatives and enhance operational efficiency. This position will also be pivotal in gathering requirements across technology and workflows, overseeing implementation, and ensuring comprehensive documentation of all automations, agents, workflows, and integrations, particularly for CRM and other critical business systems.

Responsibilities

Requirements Management

  • Elicit, analyze, and document system and user interface requirements from diverse stakeholders, drawing on experience across wealth management and technology.

  • Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical specifications, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Prioritize requirements based on business value, feasibility, and compliance factors to maximize impact.

  • Collaborate closely with development teams to ensure final solutions accurately reflect defined requirements.

  • Manage iterative changes throughout the development lifecycle, maintaining focus on delivering business value.

Platform Management

  • Contribute to the selection, configuration, and deployment of AI and technology platforms.

  • Develop, train, and fine-tune AI agents to perform specific tasks or provide intelligent assistance.

  • Monitor the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions, making adjustments as needed.

  • Work to integrate AI capabilities seamlessly into existing workflows and applications.

  • Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and best practices to continually enhance capabilities.

Documentation and Process Improvement

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation for all automated processes, workflows, and AI agent configurations.

  • Maintain detailed records of system integration architectures and API specifications.

  • Prepare user guides and training materials for new automations and integrated features.

  • Identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks in current operational processes.

  • Propose and implement innovative automation and integration solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and overall business processes.

  • Measure and report on the impact of implemented process improvements and new documentation standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant experience in automation, workflow development, and system integration, preferably within financial services.

  • Proficiency in designing and implementing integrations between various business systems, including CRM platforms.

  • Strong Analytical Skills: Ability to gather, interpret, and synthesize data to identify insights, patterns, and root causes of issues.

  • Requirements Elicitation and Documentation: Expertise in interviewing stakeholders, running workshops, and using methodologies· (e.g., user stories, use cases, process flows) to capture and document current and desired states.

  • Effective Communication: Proficiency in clearly conveying findings, recommendations, and requirements to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Change Management: Ability to manage iterative updates in requirements, communicating changes effectively and ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

  • Demonstrated experience configuring, deploying, and managing AI platforms and agents (for example, LLM-based assistants and workflow automations).

  • Strong understanding of system and user interface requirements gathering and management.

  • Ability to organize work, manage time, and balance multiple concurrent priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment under ambiguity.

  • Self-directed and able to take initiative without needing close supervision, while knowing when to escalate.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional documentation and cross-functional collaboration with colleagues at all levels.

  • Adaptable and willing to learn new tools, platforms, and methodologies as the role and function evolve.

  • Proficiency with the Microsoft 365 suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint).

Preferred

  • Prior experience within a broker-dealer, RIA, or other regulated financial services environment.

  • Experience with Zoho CRM and HubSpot

  • Experience in supporting technology transformations or operational redesign initiatives.

  • Familiarity with project management or workflow platforms (e.g., Monday.com or comparable).

Cultural Fit

The ideal candidate brings energy, accountability, and a service-oriented mindset to everything they do. They thrive in an environment that values collaboration over silos, candor over politics, and follow-through over flash. Specifically, the Business Systems Analyst embodies our values:

  • Personal: Builds genuine relationships with colleagues and stakeholders and treats every interaction as an opportunity to add value.

  • Authentic: Communicates honestly, owns mistakes, and is comfortable raising issues before they become problems.

  • Collaborative: Brings others along, shares credit generously, and works across functions without ego.

  • Knowledgeable: Demonstrates curiosity, asks thoughtful questions, and invests in learning the business they support.

Why Mutual

Joining Mutual means joining a financial services firm where the work you do has visible, tangible impact. We are big enough to support an established platform and small enough that individual contributions are seen, valued, and rewarded. We invest in our people through competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, ongoing professional development, and a leadership team that takes its responsibility to our employees as seriously as its responsibility to our advisors and clients.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) participation with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonus

  • Opportunity to help shape an emerging function and grow alongside it.

Salary Range

Annual base salary range (full-time equivalent):$95,000 to $125,000.

Final offer will be commensurate with the selected candidate’s experience, demonstrated capabilities, and internal equity considerations. The position is also eligible for discretionary performance-based bonus consideration.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a current resume and a brief cover letter describing their interest in the role and relevant systems, automation, or AI experience to the firm’s Human Resources team at . Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with the sales leadership to understand customer requirements and enable technical solutions deployment based on customer needs.

Create repeatable processes. Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution architectures, integration guides, and best practices.

Ideally, you'd have:

  • 8+ years experience as a Solutions Architect/Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Forward Deployment Engineer or in a similar technical pre-sales role.

With nearly 40 years of operating history, our track record is solid: disciplined in downturns and built to accelerate in recovery. The CardWorks Financial Group companies take precise approach in complex markets, as a top three non-prime focused general purpose card issuer and a top fifteen U.S. merchant acquirer.

Our team tackles the industry’s most complex credit and payment challenges. And we believe that excellent work starts with a team that feels supported, respected, and empowered to grow.

Position Summary and Role Impact:

The Senior, Technology Project Manager (STPM) is a senior individual contributor responsible for converting approved business and technology priorities into coordinated, executable delivery plans. The role leads complex, cross-functional initiatives from initiation through implementation and closure, integrating scope, schedules, resources, financials, dependencies, testing, business readiness, governance, and change control to achieve defined outcomes.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, the STPM partners with Product, Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Quality, Finance, and external vendors. The position applies Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery practices as appropriate, while maintaining disciplined project governance, transparent JIRA and Confluence records, and concise executive reporting.

In this role, the STPM is expected to create clarity in ambiguous situations, anticipate cross-team impacts, challenge assumptions constructively, drive timely decisions, hold teams accountable for commitments, and escalate delivery risks with context, business impact, options, and recommendations.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead complex technology initiatives from intake and initiation through implementation and closure, establishing clear scope, outcomes, milestones, delivery approach, and success measures.
  • Create and maintain integrated delivery plans that align cross-functional workstreams, resources, budgets, dependencies, testing, business readiness, and production implementation activities.

Requirements for Success:

  • Execution discipline: Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous objectives into structured plans, clear ownership, measurable milestones, and timely delivery.
  • Risk and decision management: Sound judgment in identifying delivery threats, evaluating trade-offs, escalating early, and driving timely decisions and corrective actions.
  • Technical fluency: Sufficient understanding of software development, system integration, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, DevOps, and deployment practices to challenge assumptions and coordinate technical delivery.
  • Agile leadership: Ability to coach teams on Scrum practices, improve flow and predictability, remove impediments, and maintain focus on outcomes rather than ceremonies alone.

raw.description:
ABOUT PERLE

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

Apply here:

THE ROLE

We are hiring expert North Levantine Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.

You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.

DIALECT AND SCOPE

North Levantine Arabic (Shami) as spoken across Syria and Lebanon, with the major Damascus and Beirut urban standards alongside regional and rural variations. Project audio includes natural code-switching with French (especially Lebanon) and English.

Primary speaker regions: Damascus, Aleppo, Homs, Latakia, Beirut, Tripoli (Lebanon).

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide
  • Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music
  • Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech
  • Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions
  • Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery
  • Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

  • Native fluency in Syrian or Lebanese Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in the Levant
  • Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on Levantine speech
  • Ability to distinguish Syrian and Lebanese varieties and major urban-rural splits
  • Comfortable transcribing Levantine code-switching with English and French
  • At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience
  • Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure
  • Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback
  • Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace
  • Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in Levantine linguistics, translation, journalism, or broadcast media
  • Prior experience annotating Levantine or pan-Arab speech datasets
  • Working knowledge of French for Lebanese code-switching
  • Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems
  • Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

  • Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate
  • Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround
  • Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects
  • Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team
  • Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

Apply here:

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Perle hires experts on the basis of skill, language proficiency, and demonstrated quality. We welcome applicants from every background and every region where our target languages are spoken.
